summary: Readiness PLAN-ONLY per una futura preview UI pubblica read-only del sistema Affinity Gifts. Nessuna modifica di codice frontend in V18. Nessun pulsante spend, nessun bottone claim, nessuna mutazione inventory. Solo blueprint UI/UX e regole di safety.
required_safety_constraints: frontend MUST NOT import or expose battle_engine / battle_core / synergy_system / game_systems
any new public preview screen MUST be read-only, behind feature flag UI_AFFINITY_PUBLIC_PREVIEW_ENABLED (default false)
no UI element MAY enable inventory_mutation or affinity_points_mutation
no UI element MAY reference Borea / greek_borea / primordial_gaia by id
placeholders MUST be hardcoded strings or design-only fixtures; no live ledger data leaked to anonymous users
future_phase_gates: explicit user authorization for public preview
separate plan + apply + rollback scripts for any UI route addition
abort_conditions: any Pressable/button invoking gift-spend in any branch
any UI element referencing Borea aliases
any frontend file importing battle_engine / battle_core / synergy_system
any public route exposing canary allowlist details
